items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XIV, List of Answers on Terminology 111:1
items.html: (To the question) What is the world of concealment? Leah is called by the name the world of concealment. And it is because she stands in the place of the HGT, and is corrected in the posteriors of Ima, and she desires covered Hassadim and repels the illumination of Hochma.
